! Game text
| '''0 side — Infiltration'''<br />''Deploy Nar Shaddaa, Undercity and Scoundrel’s Luck.'' '''For''' reminder of game, your gamblers, information brokers, and spies are scoundrels. You may not deploy Nightfall or cards with ability except scoundrels and [Independent] starships. "Luke" on opponent’s [Reflections II] objective is treated as "Rebel Agent." Once per turn, may ▼ a battleground site to Nar Shaddaa. '''While''' this side up, your Force drains at systems are -1. May use 1 Force to ▲ Imperial Navigation Charts. '''Flip''' this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is 'stolen.'<br />'''7 side — Unlikely Allies'''<br />'''While''' this side up, your scoundrels are forfeit +1. Your Force generation is +1 for each battleground you occupy with a scoundrel (to a maximum of +2). "Once" on [[Scoundrel's Luck (Errata)|Scoundrel's Luck]] is treated as "twice." During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force. Once during your turn, may place a card from hand in your Used Pile or Lost Pile, shuffle that pile and take the top card into hand. '''Flip''' this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is not on table (unless you have completed a [Virtual Block 8] Kessel Run).  ||  '''0 side — Infiltration'''<br />''Deploy Nar Shaddaa, Undercity and Scoundrel’s Luck.'' '''For''' reminder of game, your gamblers, information brokers, and spies are scoundrels. You may not deploy Nightfall or cards with ability except scoundrels and [Independent] starships. "Luke" on opponent’s [Reflections II] objective is treated as "{{Errata hl|1=Kyle Katarn}}." Once per turn, may ▼ a battleground site to Nar Shaddaa. '''While''' this side up, your Force drains at systems are -1. May use 1 Force to ▲ Imperial Navigation Charts. '''Flip''' this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is 'stolen.'<br />'''7 side — Unlikely Allies'''<br />'''While''' this side up, your scoundrels are forfeit +1. Your Force generation is +1 for each battleground you occupy with a scoundrel (to a maximum of +2). "Once" on [[Scoundrel's Luck (Errata)|Scoundrel's Luck]] is treated as "twice." During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force. Once during your turn, may place a card from hand in your Used Pile or Lost Pile, shuffle that pile and take the top card into hand. '''Flip''' this card if Imperial Navigation Charts is not on table (unless you have completed a [Virtual Block 8] Kessel Run).
